items.title: Hackers Use ‘rn’ Typo Trick to Impersonate Marriott in New Phishing Attack
items.description: A sophisticated “homoglyph” phishing campaign targeting customers of Marriott International and Microsoft. Attackers are registering domains that replace the letter “m” with the combination “rn” (r + n), creating fake websites that look nearly identical to the real ones. items.title: Microsoft releases emergency OOB update to fix Outlook freezes
items.description: Microsoft has released emergency, out-of-band updates on Saturday for Windows 10, Windows 11, and Windows Server to fix an issue that prevented Microsoft Outlook classic from opening when using PSTs stored in cloud storage. [...]

items.title: CISA Warns of Critical VMware vCenter RCE Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks
items.description: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added a critical vulnerability affecting Broadcom’s VMware vCenter Server to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog. This addition confirms that active exploitation of CVE-2024-37079 has been detected in the wild, posing a significant risk to enterprise environments that rely on vCenter for virtualization management. items.title: ShinyHunters claim hacks of Okta, Microsoft SSO accounts for data theft
items.description: The ShinyHunters extortion gang claims it is behind a wave of ongoing voice phishing attacks targeting single sign-on (SSO) accounts at Okta, Microsoft, and Google, enabling threat actors to breach corporate SaaS platforms and steal company data for extortion. [...]
